notices: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt at the repository root is the authoritative aggregate notice and must remain consistent with this file.
The windgrams and skyjuice source checkouts contain no LICENSE file; this component records that fact and does not claim a license for those repositories.
The published @azohra/meteo.grib decoder is used through its public API only. J2K DRT 5.40 uses the package's published j2k-node pool.
GFS raw fields remain on local or runner cache only; no raw model inputs are published as artifacts.
GRIB quantization tolerance is derived from Section 5 binary/decimal scaling as 0.5 * 2^E * 10^-D per field, summed for a companion difference plus 1e-9.
